tasks.title: Create and Switch to Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure the model `mod8-backup-lab` exists and is the active target.
hints: Run `juju switch mod8-backup-lab` or `juju add-model mod8-backup-lab`.

tasks.title: Create Controller Backup Archive
tasks.instructions: Generate a disaster recovery backup archive of the controller named `backup.tar.gz` using `juju create-backup --filename backup.tar.gz`.

tasks.title: Configure Subsystem Model Logging
tasks.instructions: Configure the model `logging-config` to enable detailed tracing on uniter workers and debug on units: `<root>=INFO;unit=DEBUG;juju.worker.uniter=TRACE`.

tasks.title: Verify Model Status & Log Replay
tasks.instructions: Execute a non-blocking debug-log replay command to verify operational telemetry: `juju debug-log --replay --no-tail -n 10`.
